text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Happy New—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yay...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes. Um, I look forward to working 
with you this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm sorry, I suddenly came back to 
my senses after looking around...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite losing momentum at the end, Zenno 
Rob Roy approached in unusually high 
spirits. The reason being, last night—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Trainer-san! Happy New Year...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally my third year since my 
debut... My Senior year."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"In order to forge ahead and make an even 
greater name for myself as a hero, I want 
to become much, much stronger."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"So! Um, with the start of the new year, 
I'll fire myself up... b-b-"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: “I'm thinking of driving it right in!”
choice_data_list: You were gonna throw a punch!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, looking forward to our first shrine 
visit of the new year first thing in the 
morning! Keep that hype up and count on 
you, alright...?!""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I came to make my New Year's 
shrine visit to fire myself up, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Over winter break, I had the 
opportunity to peruse a bit of delinquent 
manga..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, Rob Roy was an outlaw too, so I 
thought it might be good for learning what 
it takes to be a hero... or something... 
um...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I got all spun up for 
nothing... Ugh..."
choice_data_list:
New Year's Eve just gets you so hyped 
up...

New Year's Eve just gets you so hyped 
up...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... b-but it's true that I want to 
fire myself up...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do proper New Year's things...! And 
mark a clear start to giving it our all 
again this year!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like she's still a bit influenced 
by delinquent manga... but I want to enjoy 
the New Year just as much. What should we 
do...?"
choice_data_list: Draw a fortune and leave it to fate

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Ch-Chow down"...! That sounds so 
outlaw-ish...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go buy... some osechi, or 
maybe sweet red bean soup...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san! This osechi has Japanese 
spiny lobster in it! Spiny lobster...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-What should we do about the ozoni 
soup...? There's already a lot of osechi, 
so maybe make just a little less...?
choice_data_list: Five rice cakes to give you energy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Five whole mochi?! Th-That's way too 
outlaw...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I-I might've eaten a bit too much... But 
it was so delicious...! Now then, what 
should we do ne—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Whoaaa...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, I couldn't help yawning once 
my stomach got full...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy looked a little sleepy. We 
decided to spend the New Year's afternoon 
relaxing in the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Leaving luck to the heavens... Sounds 
nice. It gives off a bit of a 
gambler-esque, slightly outlaw vibe.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, I think the fortune slips are over 
there...? Let's go check it out...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, how was it? I, well... um... 
hmm..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Were you able to tie your fortune slip 
properly?
choice_data_list: Rob Roy doesn't have to tie hers, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I was thinking... I might just take 
it home as is...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Um... thank you so much. I never 
imagined you'd trade your Great Blessing 
with me...
choice_data_list: Because your good luck is my good luck.

Because your good fortune is my good 
fortune.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. With this great fortune, I feel 
like... it'll give me courage during my 
races too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, shall we check out the 
food stalls too?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Drawing lots, huh... Hmm, I wonder if I'd 
be using up my good luck...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spent time checking out the food stalls 
until past noon. I'm a little tired from 
walking, so I think I'll relax in the 
Trainer's Office this afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Throwing down...!! That sounds so totally 
outlaw...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Understood, to the department store... we 
charge in...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer~! Where are youuu~...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're already getting swept away by 
the crowd...! Hang on, I'm coming to save 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Department Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Only three of these New Year's Lucky Bags 
left in stock~!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-Only 3 bags left...!? Trainer-san or the 
lucky bag... Love or glory...?! A truly 
heroic dilemma...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...So, were you able to buy anything?
choice_data_list:
A lucky bag from some shop I don't even 
know...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Me too... I felt like I just had to buy 
something... I was so desperate... that 
for some reason, I ended up getting a 
driftwood lucky bag..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
B-But, you see, I got to check out all 
kinds of shops, so I guess you could say 
my horizons have broadened...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea lucky bags with driftwood 
even existed until now...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so exhausted... I think I'll take 
it easy in the Trainer's Room this 
afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the TV... They're showing a New Year's 
racing special.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"—However, looking back on last year, 
Symboli Kris S's incredible performance 
truly left a lasting impression, didn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, indeed! She truly was... an 
Umamusume who possessed such a 
magnificent, overwhelming presence."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
“Her consistent record of always fighting 
for the top spots is impressive, of 
course, but above all, the way she won was 
simply breathtaking!”

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"‘While quietly delivering results, she 
also showed us overpowering victories... 
She was truly a ruthless professional.’"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"...It really is a shame, this 
retirement... To think we won't be able to 
see her run ever again..."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... the Twinkle Series will feel 
lonely without them. It's almost as if 
we've lost our leading star, wouldn't you 
say?"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"However!! What we really want to focus on 
here are this year's Classic-class 
Umamusume! ...Right?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The Classic Year—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, indeed! In fact, a very interesting 
Umamusume has just stepped onto the 
scene!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Two consecutive wins since her debut! 
Given her illustrious pedigree, 
expectations were already sky-high, but 
she has shown talent more than equal to 
the task in this race—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the broadcast shifted entirely 
to talk of the Classic-class Umamusume. 
...It seems some remarkably dazzling 
talents are rising to the top.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although Zenno Rob Roy fought admirably 
last year as well, she ended up not 
receiving much media spotlight, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'm so glad I got to go on 
Hatsumode with you today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A fresh start... I have to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I may be plain and inconspicuous, but 
that's exactly why... I want to keep 
making steady efforts so I'm not 
overshadowed by our great predecessors or 
energetic up-and-comers.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...After everything that's happened, I 
think it made me realize something all 
over again."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
My dream of becoming a hero... and my goal 
of becoming a lingering thought for the 
one I admire... It feels like I just 
couldn't give up on any of it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I must be stubborn to an almost pathetic 
degree."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's why... even if it's plain, I'll 
take it step by step. Tenacious, stubborn, 
and clinging to my dreams, I'll keep 
building myself up piece by piece.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And someday, I want to become a hero 
acknowledged by everyone—!
choice_data_list: You're right! Let's do our best...!
You're right! Let's give it our all...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy smiles resolutely and nods. 
In the Senior Year, let's start by 
steadily stacking up results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Striving to become that ideal "hero" whose 
name anyone would naturally want to 
speakâ

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“Now then! This broadcast has turned into 
an extra-long special, and it is finally 
time to say goodbye!”

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, as a final question... may I 
ask which Umamusume all of you are 
currently keeping a particularly close eye 
on?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. ...I really wanted to talk about 
this at the end."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Truth is, she hasn't even debuted yet, 
but there's this incredible girl."

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, huh? What's with this room? The 
TV's still on.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "You know, when I saw that girl run—"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "It left such a huge impact on me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A patroller from the academy staff turned 
off the TV that had been left on.
